mapper.select: SELECT T.notice_id, T.title, T.category_cd, U.user_name, T.create_dt, T.view_count, T.del_yn FROM t3000_notice T JOIN T1000_account A ON COALESCE(T.update_Id, T.create_id) = A.account_id JOIN t1000_user U ON A.user_no = U.user_no WHERE T.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY T.notice_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t3000_notice SET title = #{title}, content=#{content}, update_id = #{updateId}, category_cd = #{categoryCd}, popup_yn = #{popupYn}, update_dt = SYSDATE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
